scope: Feedback module image upload JavaScript actions in the exported TypeScript client

differential.method: the original module sources (with big.js and a stub of mx-api/ui) and the TypeScript adapter driven by the same jsdom file input events

semantics: accepted types are regular expressions tested against the MIME type; an empty list accepts everything
the size limit in MB is the first digit of the big.js coefficient (maxSize.c[0]) plus 0.1
a cancelled dialog resolves uploadCancelled and leaves the hidden input in the page
revoking without a URL fails with 'Image was not removed from browser memory'
message dialogs get z-index 90 and the underlay 80 after 500 ms; the module's mx-dialog-warning selector lacks its dot
limitations: the native Mendix client was not driven through a real file chooser; equivalence comes from executing the original source
